{{Top|leg}}
A '''symphony''' was a type of [[Music/Legends|musical]] composition performed by symphony [[orchestra]]s. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Hunn]] pleaded to an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual for the lives of a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], requesting to let them leave to compose symphonies or whatever else they were proficient in.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Borna]] wrote at least two symphonies, [[Borna's second symphony|the second of which]] was a protest to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
